primary_target: geomean(fresh fastest-GAGP search_s / fresh candidate search_s) >=2 separately for both populations and pooled 60 cells; full30, not selected subset

quality.preferred: identical scores, wrong counts, generation champion ASTs and full final population ASTs under unchanged RNG/operators
quality.fresh_validation: all30 tasks, paired seeds, new disjoint train/test; global G/seeds frozen by development runtime forecast before fresh test creation
quality.noninferiority_margin: 5 percentage points paired success difference lower 95% bound; if underpowered report inconclusive, never equate non-significance with equivalence
quality.hard_reject: any confirmed native CPU fitness/wrong discrepancy or degradation from execution-only change

development.selection: training, runtime and execution fidelity only; no heldout-guided tuning

preservation: Never modify old studies, overwrite attempts, resample failed parents, replace GPU reproduction, or hide failures. Pin each attempt binary/source/settings/inputs. nsys diagnostics only; unprofiled search-wall for ratios.
